name: ofs-2024.1-1 Release for AFU Examples Repository
body:
# OFS 2024.1-1
## Summary: OFS 2024.1-1 Release for AFU Examples Repository

For the overall release and associated repositories you can use with this release, please review the [Discussions post](https://github.com/orgs/OFS/discussions/).
For complete documentation go to the [OFS Documentation site](https://ofs.github.io)

This repository contains RTL and OneAPI workloads examples and tutorials you can use with your own OFS-based shell design.

What's new in the ofs-2024.1-1 release?

* New DMA Workload (AFU) that allows you to test moving data between host memory and FPGA local memory.  See the [DMA folder](https://github.com/OFS/examples-afu/tree/main/tutorial/afu_types/01_pim_ifc/dma).
